record.final_answer:
18 GB.

From the Ferrocache 5.2 sizing guide we went through (docs.ferrocache.example/sizing, read 2026-06-02): maxmemory caps only the dataset — replication buffers, client output buffers and fragmentation sit on top. A node with replication should get at least 1.5x maxmemory; without, 1.25x.

So 12 GB × 1.5 = 18 GB. That's the floor, not a target — give the VM some headroom above 18 GB if the node also holds client output buffers under load or runs anything else.
